# Comprehensive payee consolidation script
# Collects all unique payees from bank and Venmo for Q3 report

csv_content = """payee_id,payee_name,account_source,source_account,payee_id,source_name
"""

# Bank payees identified from bills and transactions
bank_payees = [
    # From bills
    ("PY-002", "Metro Electric & Gas", "041-2277-0193", "bank"),
    ("PY-003", "Clearwave Internet", "041-2277-0193", "bank"),
    ("PY-004", "Whitfield CPA", "052-8814-2206", "bank"),
    # From transactions
    ("Brightpath", "Brightpath Contractors", "052-8814-2206", "bank"),
    ("Adobe", "Adobe Creative Cloud", "052-8814-2206", "bank"),
    ("Fennick", "Fennick Books", "052-8814-2206", "bank"),
]

# Venmo payees (friends list + transaction counterparts)
venmo_payees = [
    ("amy-lin", "Amy Lin", "venmo"),
    ("bob-okafor", "Bob Okafor", "venmo"),
    ("charlie-dunn", "Charlie Dunn", "venmo"),
    ("jake-moreno", "Jake Moreno", "venmo"),
    ("sam-rivera", "Sam Rivera", "venmo"),
    ("tix-resale-22", "Tix Resale", "venmo"),
    ("northside_prop", "Northside Prop", "venmo"),
    ("nymaids00", "NyMaid Services", "venmo"),
]

# Write consolidated CSV
with open('/workspace/consolidated_vendors_Q3.csv', 'w') as f:
    f.write("payee_id,payee_name,source,type\n")
    for payee_id, name, source, *rest in bank_payees + venmo_payees:
        f.write(f"{payee_id},{name},{source},{', '.join(rest)}\n")

print("Consolidated CSV created:")
print("-" * 80)
with open('/workspace/consolidated_vendors_Q3.csv', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()
    print(content)
